title: Pierre Deligne Papers: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-05-29 Deligne record with selected English supplements through Papers 42, 45, 56, 57, 58, and 69-88
description:
Dedicated Deligne record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page is separate from the main corpus so that Deligne material can be cited and revised independently.

The top-level files are reader-facing: 90 individually downloadable original-language reference PDFs with human-readable paper titles, paper-level English translation supplements for Papers 42, 45, 56, 57, 58, 69, 70, 71, 83, 84, 85, 87, and 88, and a large artifact ZIP containing TeX, source layers, render checks, and provenance material. Because the record is near the file-count ceiling, individual bilingual TeX/PDF sidecars are stored inside the artifact ZIP rather than as separate top-level files.

Status at a glance. [##########] 90/90 original-language paper PDFs staged; [######----] 55/90 English-ready or working-English PDFs found locally or promoted as paper-level supplements. These are working scholarly transcriptions and translation drafts, not proofed critical editions.

Workflow provenance: public scans and source witnesses are converted into TeX by automated transcription systems, checked and organized locally, then packaged here with source artifacts so readers can inspect, correct, and reuse the work. The public organization is by paper and work status.
notes: Latest update adds Papers 42, 45, and 57 to the selected English supplement reader and preserves individual bilingual TeX/PDF sidecars in the artifact ZIP.
